Arctic Small Tool tradition.headline: Arktična tradicija drobnega orodja
paragraphs: Arktična tradicija drobnega orodja (ASTt) je bila široka kulturna skupnost, ki se je okoli leta 2500 pr. n. št. razvila ob Aljaškem polotoku, okoli Bristolskega zaliva in na vzhodni obali Beringove ožine. Njene skupine so bile prvi prebivalci arktične Kanade in Grenlandije. Šlo je za kopensko kulturo z zelo značilnim orodjem, ki je temeljilo na tehnologiji mikrorezil. Med tipičnimi orodji so strgala, vbadala ter stranska in konična rezila, ki so jih vstavljali v sestavljene puščice ali sulice iz drugih snovi, na primer kosti ali rogovja. Mnogi raziskovalci domnevajo tudi, da so prav te skupine na Arktiko prinesle lok in puščico, iz katerih se je pozneje razvila eskimska lokostrelska kultura. Tabore te tradicije pogosto najdejo ob obalah in potokih, kjer so lovili tjulnje in losose. Nekatere skupine so bile precej nomadske, na najdiščih pa so odkrili tudi trajnejša bivališča s strehami iz ruše.

source.title: Arctic Small Tool tradition
paragraphs: The Arctic Small Tool tradition (ASTt) was a broad cultural entity that developed along the Alaska Peninsula, around Bristol Bay, and on the eastern shores of the Bering Strait around 2500 BC. ASTt groups were the first human occupants of Arctic Canada and Greenland. This was a terrestrial entity that had a highly distinctive toolkit based on microblade technology. Typically tool types include scrapers, burins and side and end blades used in composite arrows or spears made of other materials, such as bone or antler. Many researchers also assume that it was Arctic Small Tool populations who first introduced the bow and arrow to the Arctic, that eventually became the Eskimo archery material culture. ASTt camps are often found along coasts and streams, to take advantage of seal or salmon populations. While some of the groups were fairly nomadic, more permanent, sod-roofed homes have also been identified from Arctic Small Tool tradition sites.

Argentinska konfederacija (špansko: Confederación Argentina) je bila zadnja predhodnica sodobne Argentine; njeno ime je po 35. členu argentinske ustave še vedno eno od uradnih imen države. Tako se je država imenovala od leta 1831 do 1852, ko so bile province povezane v konfederacijo brez voditelja države. Zunanje odnose je tedaj vodil guverner province Buenos Aires, večino obdobja Juan Manuel de Rosas. Pod njegovo vladavino se je konfederacija zapletla v spore z Brazilijo, Bolivijo, Urugvajem, Francijo in Združenim kraljestvom ter z drugimi argentinskimi frakcijami v argentinskih državljanskih vojnah.

Rosasa je leta 1852 po bitki pri Caserosu vrgel z oblasti Justo José de Urquiza, ki je leta 1853 sklical ustavodajno skupščino, da bi napisala državno ustavo. Buenos Aires se je Urquizi uprl, se leta 1852 odcepil od konfederacije in postal Država Buenos Aires; v Argentino se je provinca vrnila leta 1861.

source.title: Argentine Confederation
paragraphs: The Argentine Confederation (Spanish: Confederación Argentina) was the last predecessor state of modern Argentina; its name is still one of the official names of the country according to the Argentine Constitution, Article 35. It was the name of the country from 1831 to 1852, when the provinces were organized as a confederation without a head of state. The governor of Buenos Aires Province (Juan Manuel de Rosas during most of the period) managed foreign relations during this time. Under his rule, the Argentine Confederation engaged in conflicts with Brazil, Bolivia, Uruguay, France and the United Kingdom, as well as other Argentine factions during the Argentine Civil Wars.

Rosas was ousted from power in 1852 by Justo José de Urquiza, after the battle of Caseros. Urquiza convened the 1853 Constituent Assembly to write a national constitution. Buenos Aires resisted Urquiza and seceded from the Confederation in 1852, becoming the State of Buenos Aires; the province would return to Argentina in 1861.

Aymara lordships.headline: Ajmarska gospostva
paragraphs: Ajmarska gospostva, imenovana tudi ajmarska kraljestva ali kraljestva ob jezeru, so bila skupina domorodnih političnih skupnosti, ki so se razcvetele proti poznemu vmesnemu obdobju, po padcu Tiahunaškega imperija, v pokrajini Qullaw. Razvijala so se med letoma 1150 in 1477, nato pa so izginila, ko jih je vojaško osvojil Inkovski imperij. Današnje ajmarsko prebivalstvo v Boliviji, Peruju, Čilu in Argentini kljub temu šteje približno dva milijona ljudi. Govorili so ajmarščino in puquinščino.

source.title: Aymara lordships
paragraphs: The Aymara lordships, Aymara kingdoms, or lake kingdoms were a group of native polities that flourished towards the Late Intermediate Period, after the fall of the Tiwanaku Empire, whose societies were geographically located in the Qullaw. They were developed between 1150 and 1477, before the kingdoms disappeared due to the military conquest of the Inca Empire. But the current Aymara population is estimated at two million located in the countries of Bolivia, Peru, Chile and Argentina. They used the Aymara and Puquina languages.

Burbonska restavracija je bilo obdobje francoske zgodovine, ko se je po padcu Napoleona Bonaparta v letih 1814 in 1815 na oblast vrnila rodbina Burbonov. V Francijo, ki jo je francoska revolucija globoko spremenila, so se vrnili izgnani privrženci monarhije. Kraljestvo, izčrpano od napoleonskih vojn, je doživelo obdobje notranjega in zunanjega miru, stabilne gospodarske blaginje in začetkov industrializacije. Restavracijo je dejansko končala julijska revolucija leta 1830, med vladavino Karla X., brata pokojnega kralja Ludvika XVI.; sledili sta ji julijska monarhija in nazadnje druga francoska republika.

source.title: Bourbon Restoration in France
paragraphs: The Bourbon Restoration was the period of French history during which the House of Bourbon returned to power after the fall of Napoleon Bonaparte in 1814 and 1815. Exiled supporters of the monarchy returned to France, which had been profoundly changed by the French Revolution. Exhausted by the Napoleonic Wars, the kingdom experienced a period of internal and external peace, stable economic prosperity and the preliminaries of industrialisation. The July Revolution of 1830 effectively ended the restoration during the reign of Charles X, brother of the late King Louis XVI, leading to the July Monarchy and eventually the French Second Republic.

Cañari.headline: Cañari
paragraphs: Cañari (v jeziku kičva: Kañari) so domorodna etnična skupina, ki tradicionalno poseljuje ozemlje današnjih provinc Azuay in Cañar v Ekvadorju. Izhajajo iz istoimenske neodvisne predkolumbovske plemenske zveze. Zgodovinsko ljudstvo je znano predvsem po odporu proti Inkovskemu imperiju. Inki so ga osvojili v začetku 16. stoletja, malo pred prihodom Špancev, Cañari pa so se nato s Španci povezali proti Inkom. Danes jih je, skupaj s številnimi mestici, več tisoč.

Njihovi predniki so ozemlje več let branili pred številnimi inkovskimi vojskami. Túpac Yupanqui je osvojil Huancabambe, najjužnejše zaveznike Cañarov. Inkovski imperij je pod vodstvom Huayne Capaca z vojnami in porokami nazadnje osvojil njihovo ozemlje na severu. Cañari so se v obsežni imperij vključili le ohlapno: smeli so sami urejati svoje zadeve, za sporazumevanje z Inki pa so prevzeli nov jezik.

source.title: Cañari
paragraphs: The Cañari (in Kichwa: Kañari) are an indigenous ethnic group traditionally inhabiting the territory of the modern provinces of Azuay and Cañar in Ecuador. They are descended from the independent pre-Columbian tribal confederation of the same name. The historic people are particularly noted for their resistance against the Inca Empire. Eventually conquered by the Inca in the early 16th century shortly before the arrival of the Spanish, the Cañari later allied with the Spanish against the Inca. Today, the population of the Cañari, who include many mestizos, numbers in the thousands.

The earlier people defended their territory for many years against numerous Incan armies. Túpac Yupanqui conquered the Huancabambas, the most southern of the Cañari allies. Through wars and marriages, the Inca Empire under the lead of Huayna Capac to the north finally conquered their territory. The Cañari were loosely assimilated into the vast empire, allowed to manage their own affairs but adopting a new language for communicating with the Inca.

Capulí culture.headline: Kultura Capulí
paragraphs: Kultura Capulí (ali kultura Nariño) je arheološka oznaka za skupino v predkolumbovski Južni Ameriki, ki je živela na andski planoti na območju današnjega severnega Ekvadorja (provinca Carchi) in južne Kolumbije (departma Nariño). V arheoloških plasteh je pred kulturama Piartal in Tuza in sega od okoli leta 800 do 1500 n. št. Za seboj je pustila bogato lončenino: značilni so črni okraski na temno rdeči podlagi s pravokotnimi geometrijskimi vzorci. Antropomorfni lončeni kipci so lahko izjemno izraziti. Ženske so upodobljene v ogrinjalu od pazduhe do gležnjev, moški v ledvenih predpasnikih, pogosto s predmetom, na primer bobnom ali živaljo. Te figure pogosto imenujejo coqueros, ker imajo v ustih kepe listov koke. Raziskovalci jih povezujejo s šamani in morda s pogrebnimi obredi.

source.title: Capulí culture
paragraphs: The Capulí culture (or Nariño culture) refers to an archaeological classification for a group in Pre-Columbian South America on the Andean plain in what is now northern Ecuador (Carchi Province) and southern Colombia (Nariño Department). The Capulí preceded the Piartal and Tuza cultures in the archaeological record ranging from around 800 to 1500 CE. The Capulí culture left a strong record through its pottery. The Capulí had distinctive black on dark red pottery with rectilinear geometric designs. The anthropomorphic pottery statues of the Capulí can be striking. Women are depicted with a wrap that extends from the armpit to the ankle while men have loincloths and are often shown with an object such as a drum or animal. These figures are often called coqueros because they are depicted with wads of coca leaves in their mouths. Scholars have associated the figures with shamans and possible funerary rituals.

Centralistična republika Mehika (špansko: República Centralista de México), v angleški strokovni literaturi tudi Centralna republika, uradno Mehiška republika (República Mexicana), je bila unitarna politična ureditev, ki so jo v Mehiki vzpostavili 23. oktobra 1835 z novo ustavo, imenovano Siete Leyes (»sedem zakonov«), potem ko so konservativci razveljavili federalistično ustavo iz leta 1824 in končali prvo mehiško republiko. Trajala je do leta 1846, ko so ob začetku mehiško-ameriške vojne znova uveljavili ustavo iz leta 1824.
V tem obdobju sta prevladovala predsednika Santa Anna in Anastasio Bustamante.

source.title: Centralist Republic of Mexico
paragraphs: The Centralist Republic of Mexico (Spanish: República Centralista de México), or in the anglophone scholarship, the Central Republic, officially the Mexican Republic (Spanish: República Mexicana), was a unitary political regime established in Mexico on 23 October 1835, under a new constitution known as the Siete Leyes (lit. 'seven laws') after conservatives repealed the federalist Constitution of 1824 and ended the First Mexican Republic. It would ultimately last until 1846, when the Constitution of 1824 was restored at the beginning of the Mexican–American War.
Two presidents would predominate throughout this era: Santa Anna and Anastasio Bustamante.

Chachapoya culture.headline: Kultura Chachapoya
paragraphs: Chachapoye, imenovani tudi »bojevniki oblakov«, so bili andska kultura, ki je živela v oblačnih gozdovih južnega dela departmaja Amazonas v današnjem Peruju. Inkovski imperij je njihovo civilizacijo osvojil malo pred španskim osvajanjem v 16. stoletju. Ob prihodu konkvistadorjev so bili Chachapoye eno od mnogih ljudstev pod inkovsko oblastjo, čeprav so jih zaradi nenehnega upiranja inkovskim četam težko vključili v imperij.

source.title: Chachapoya culture
paragraphs: The Chachapoyas, also called the "Warriors of the Clouds," were a culture of the Andes living in the cloud forests of the southern part of the Department of Amazonas of present-day Peru. The Inca Empire conquered their civilization shortly before the Spanish conquest in the 16th century. At the time of the arrival of the conquistadores, the Chachapoyas were one of the many nations ruled by the Incas, although their incorporation had been difficult due to their constant resistance to Inca troops.

Chinchorro culture.headline: Kultura Chinchorro
paragraphs: Kultura Chinchorro je bila predkeramična kultura Južne Amerike, ki je trajala od 9100 do 3500 let pred sedanjostjo (od 7000 do 1500 pr. n. št.). Njeni nosilci so bili stalno naseljeni ribiči na pacifiški obali današnjega severnega Čila in južnega Peruja; naselitev je omogočila sladka voda v sicer sušni obalni pokrajini. Ljudstvo je slovelo po skrbnem mumificiranju in pogrebnih obredih. Okoli 4000 let pred sedanjostjo so na območje začeli prihajati vplivi z andske planote, ki so privedli do poljedelstva; mnogo pozneje se je znašlo pod vplivom Tiahunaškega imperija.
Leta 2021 so kulturo Chinchorro vpisali na Unescov seznam svetovne dediščine.

source.title: Chinchorro culture
paragraphs: The Chinchorro culture of South America was a preceramic culture that lasted from 9,100 to 3,500 years BP (7,000 to 1,500 BCE). The people forming the Chinchorro culture were sedentary fishermen inhabiting the Pacific coastal region of current northern Chile and southern Peru. Presence of fresh water in the arid region on the coast facilitated human settlement in this area. The Chinchorro were famous for their detailed mummification and funerary practices. The area of the Chinchorro culture started to receive influences from the Andean Plateau around 4,000 BP, which led to the adoption of agriculture. Much later, it came under the influence of the Tiwanaku Empire.
In 2021, the Chinchorro culture was included in the UNESCO World Heritage List.

Ciboney.headline: Ciboney
paragraphs: Ciboney ali Siboney so bili domorodno ljudstvo Kube, haitijskega polotoka Tiburon in morda Jamajke. Po mnenju nekaterih raziskovalcev, med njimi Juliana Granberryja in Garyja Vesceliusa, so bili zahodna skupina Tainov, ki je v 15. in 16. stoletju živela na Kubi; njihovo narečje in kultura sta se razlikovala od klasičnih Tainov, ki so se s Hispaniole začeli priseljevati po letu 1450, čeprav je bil velik del njihovega ozemlja pod oblastjo vzhodnih poglavarjev. Drugi raziskovalci, med njimi L. Antonio Curet in Cayetano Coll y Toste, jih med Taine ne uvrščajo. Zaradi zmede v zgodovinskih virih so raziskovalci v 20. stoletju ime »Ciboney« uporabljali tudi za netainske Guanahatabeye na zahodu Kube in za različne arhaične kulture po Karibih, kar pa danes velja za zastarelo.
notes: The people's name is kept as Ciboney; no established Slovenian form was found.

source.title: Ciboney
paragraphs: The Ciboney ( or ), or Siboney, were an Indigenous people of Cuba, the Tiburon Peninsula of Haiti, and possibly Jamaica. According to some scholars, including Julian Granberry and Gary Vescelius, the Ciboney were a Western Taíno group living in Cuba during the 15th and 16th centuries, who had a dialect and culture distinct from the Classic Taíno who began migrating from Hispaniola after 1450, though much of the Ciboney territory was under the control of the eastern chiefs. Other scholars, including L. Antonio Curet and Cayetano Coll y Toste, do not classify the Ciboney as Taino. Confusion in the historical sources led 20th-century scholars to apply the name "Ciboney" to the non-Taíno Guanahatabey of western Cuba and various archaic cultures around the Caribbean, but this is deprecated.

Cochise tradition.headline: Tradicija Cochise
paragraphs: Tradicija Cochise (tudi kultura Cochise) je južna od štirih arhaičnih tradicij ameriškega jugozahoda, na območju današnjih jugozahodnih Združenih držav.

Trajala je skoraj pet tisočletij, od okoli leta 5000 do okoli 200 pr. n. št. Njena najzgodnejša oblika je znana kot Sulphur Spring, precej bolje pa sta znani poznejši fazi Chiricahua in San Pedro. Ime je dobila po jezeru Cochise, nekdanjem jezeru na mestu današnje usedline Willcox Playa v okrožju Cochise v Arizoni. Kaže, da je bila prednica prazgodovinskih tradicij Mogollon (Mimbres) in Hohokam.

Tradicija Cochise je del kulture Picosa, ki zajema arhaični način življenja ljudi s treh območij s povezanimi najdbami in načinom življenja. Ime ji je v 1960. letih dala Cynthia Irwin-Williams po teh območjih: Pinto Basin (PI), tradiciji Cochise (CO) in San Jose (SA), skupaj »Picosa«.

source.title: Cochise tradition
paragraphs: The Cochise tradition (also Cochise culture) is the southern archeological tradition of the four Southwestern Archaic traditions, in the present-day Southwestern United States.

The Cochise tradition lasted nearly five millennia, from circa 5000 until circa 200 BC. Its earliest manifestation is known as Sulphur Spring; its two later phases, the Chiricahua and San Pedro, are much better known. The Cochise tradition was named after Lake Cochise, an ancient lake now found in the Willcox Playa of Cochise County, Arizona. The Cochise tradition appears to be ancestral to the prehistoric Mogollon (Mimbres) and Hohokam traditions.

The Cochise tradition is part of the Picosa culture, which encapsulates the Archaic lifestyles of people from three locations with interconnected artifacts and lifestyles. It was named by Cynthia Irwin-Williams in the 1960s for those areas: Pinto Basin (PI), Cochise tradition (CO), and San Jose (SA), which together are called "Picosa".

Colla Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Colla
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Colla (tudi Qolla ali Qulla), imenovano tudi poglavarstvo ali gospostvo (señorío), je bila politična skupnost v severozahodnem porečju jezera Titicaca. Bila je segmentarna družba z mnogimi rodovi in podskupinami.

Poglavarstvo Colla je bilo eno od ajmarskih kraljestev, ki so po padcu Tiwanakuja zasedla del planote Collao. Sredi 15. stoletja so imeli Colle obsežno ozemlje, eno največjih med ajmarskimi kraljestvi; tedaj ga je skupaj z drugimi političnimi tvorbami v regiji osvojil 9. sapa inka Pachakutiq Yupanqui Qhapaq, Intipchurin (»sin sonca«). Pogosto ga opisujejo kot mogočno, enotno državo, arheološki podatki pa kažejo bolj politično razdrobljeno pokrajino, posejano z obrambnimi utrdbami, imenovanimi pukare.

Bilo je eno najpomembnejših poglavarstev na altiplanu, obsegalo je 20.000 kvadratnih kilometrov in se sklicevalo na dediščino tiahunaške civilizacije. Ljudstvo Colla je govorilo puquinščino, ki je bila morda jezik Tiwanakuja pred njegovim propadom.

source.title: Colla Kingdom
paragraphs: The Colla, Qolla or Qulla Kingdom, chiefdom or Señorio was a polity established in the northwestern basin of lake Titicaca. It was a segmentary society, containing many lineages and subgroups.

The Colla chiefdom was one of the Aymara kingdoms that occupied part of the Collao plateau after the fall of Tiwanaku. In the mid-15th century the Collas possessed a vast territory, one of the largest of the Aymara kingdoms, which at the time the 9th Sapan Inka Pachakutiq Yupanqui Qhapaq the Intipchurin ("son of the sun"), conquered along with other political entities in the region. Often described as a powerful, unified state, archeological data indicates a more politically fragmented landscape, covered by defensive forts, called pukaras.

The Colla chiefdom was one of the most important altiplano chiefdoms, covering 20.000 square kilometres, and claiming heritage from the Tiwanaku civilisation. Linguistically, the Colla nation spoke Puquina, possibly the language of Tiwanaku prior to its collapse.

Kastiljska krona, znana tudi kot krona Kastilije in Leóna, je bila srednjeveška politična tvorba na Iberskem polotoku, ki je nastala leta 1230 s tretjo in dokončno združitvijo kron, nekaj desetletij pozneje pa še parlamentov kraljestev Kastilije in Leóna, ko je tedanji kastiljski kralj Ferdinand III. zasedel izpraznjeni leonski prestol. Kot ločena enota je obstajala tudi po personalni uniji kastiljske in aragonske krone leta 1479, sklenjeni s poroko katoliških kraljev, vse do razglasitve dekretov Nueva Planta, ki jih je leta 1716 izdal Filip V.

source.title: Crown of Castile
paragraphs: The Crown of Castile, also known as the Crown of Castile and León, was a medieval polity in the Iberian Peninsula that formed in 1230 as a result of the third and definitive union of the crowns and, some decades later, the parliaments of the kingdoms of Castile and León upon the accession of the then Castilian king, Ferdinand III, to the vacant Leonese throne. It continued to exist as a separate entity after the personal union in 1479 of the crowns of Castile and Aragon with the marriage of the Catholic Monarchs up to the promulgation of the Nueva Planta decrees by Philip V in 1716.

Cupisnique.headline: Kultura Cupisnique
paragraphs: Kultura Cupisnique je bila predkolumbovska domorodna kultura, ki je cvetela od ok. 1500 do 500 pr. n. št. na današnji severni pacifiški obali Peruja. Imela je značilen slog gradnje iz nežgane opeke (adobe). Njeni izdelki imajo skupne umetnostne sloge in verske simbole s kulturo Chavin, ki se je pozneje razvila na istem območju.

source.title: Cupisnique
paragraphs: The Cupisnique culture was a pre-Columbian indigenous culture that flourished from c. 1500 to 500 BC along what now is Peru's northern Pacific coast. The culture had a distinctive style of adobe clay architecture. Artifacts of the culture share artistic styles and religious symbols with the Chavin culture that arose in the same area at a later date.

Diaguita.headline: Diaguiti
paragraphs: Diaguiti so domorodno ljudstvo Južne Amerike s čilskega Norte Chico in argentinskega severozahoda. Zahodni ali čilski Diaguiti so živeli predvsem v prečnih dolinah, ki se zajedajo v polsušne gore, vzhodni ali argentinski pa v provincah La Rioja in Catamarca ter v delu provinc Salta, San Juan in Tucumán. Izraz Diaguita je za ljudstva in arheološke kulture v začetku 20. stoletja prvi uporabil Ricardo E. Latcham.

Stari Diaguiti niso bili enotno ljudstvo: njihov jezik ali narečja so se razlikovali od doline do doline, politično pa so bili razdrobljeni na več poglavarstev. Obalni in celinski čilski Diaguiti so med seboj trgovali, o čemer pričajo arheološke najdbe školjčnih lupin v gornjih tokovih andskih dolin.

source.title: Diaguita
paragraphs: The Diaguita people are a South American Indigenous people native to the Chilean Norte Chico and the Argentine Northwest. Western or Chilean Diaguitas lived mainly in the Transverse Valleys that incise semi-arid mountains. Eastern or Argentine Diaguitas lived in the provinces of La Rioja and Catamarca and part of the provinces of Salta, San Juan and Tucumán. The term Diaguita was first applied to peoples and archaeological cultures by Ricardo E. Latcham in the early 20th century.

Ancient Diaguitas were not a unified people; the language or dialects used by them seems to have varied from valley to valley and they were politically fragmented into several chiefdoms. Coastal and inland Chilean Diaguitas traded, as evidenced by the archaeological findings of mollusc shells in the upper courses of Andean valleys.

Dorset culture.headline: Kultura Dorset
paragraphs: Dorset je bila paleoeskimska kultura, ki je na severnoameriški Arktiki trajala od leta 500 pr. n. št. do obdobja med letoma 1000 in 1500 n. št.; sledila je kulturi Pre-Dorset, za njo pa so prišli ljudje Thule, predniki Inuitov. Kultura in ljudstvo sta dobila ime po rtu Dorset (danes Kinngait) v Nunavutu v Kanadi, kjer je zahodna znanost odkrila prve otipljive dokaze o njunem obstoju. Kulturo delijo na štiri faze, ker se tehnologije lova in izdelave orodja med njimi jasno razlikujejo. Med najdbami so značilne trikotne konice, oljne svetilke (qulliq) iz milnika in vbadala.

source.title: Dorset culture
paragraphs: The Dorset was a Paleo-Eskimo culture, lasting from 500 BCE to between 1000 CE and 1500 CE, that followed the Pre-Dorset and preceded the Thule people (proto-Inuit) in the North American Arctic. The culture and people are named after Cape Dorset (now Kinngait) in Nunavut, Canada, where the first physical evidence of its existence was found by western science. The culture has been defined as having four phases due to the distinct differences in the technologies relating to hunting and tool making. Artifacts include distinctive triangular end-blades, oil lamps (qulliq) made of soapstone, and burins.

Brazilsko cesarstvo (portugalsko: Império do Brasil) je bila država 19. stoletja, ki je v grobem obsegala ozemlje današnje Brazilije in Urugvaja, dokler se ta ni leta 1828 osamosvojil. Bilo je predstavniška parlamentarna ustavna monarhija pod vladavino cesarjev Pedra I. in njegovega sina Pedra II. Brazilija, kolonija Kraljevine Portugalske, je postala sedež Portugalskega imperija leta 1808, ko je portugalski princ regent in poznejši kralj Ivan VI. pobegnil pred Napoleonovo invazijo na Portugalsko in se z vlado naselil v brazilskem mestu Rio de Janeiro. Ivan VI. se je pozneje vrnil na Portugalsko, Kraljevino Brazilijo pa je kot regentu prepustil svojemu najstarejšemu sinu in dediču Pedru. Pedro je 7. septembra 1822 razglasil neodvisnost Brazilije in bil po uspešni vojni proti očetovemu kraljestvu 12. oktobra razglašen za Pedra I., prvega brazilskega cesarja. Nova država je bila ogromna, redko poseljena in etnično raznolika.

source.title: Empire of Brazil
paragraphs: The Empire of Brazil (Portuguese: Império do Brasil) was a 19th-century state that broadly comprised the territories which form modern Brazil and Uruguay until the latter achieved independence in 1828. The empire's government was a representative parliamentary constitutional monarchy under the rule of Emperors Pedro I and his son Pedro II. A colony of the Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil became the seat of the Portuguese Empire in 1808, when the Portuguese Prince regent, later King Dom John VI, fled from Napoleon's invasion of Portugal and established himself and his government in the Brazilian city of Rio de Janeiro. John VI later returned to Portugal, leaving his eldest son and heir-apparent, Pedro, to rule the Kingdom of Brazil as regent. On 7 September 1822, Pedro declared the independence of Brazil and, after waging a successful war against his father's kingdom, was acclaimed on 12 October as Pedro I, the first Emperor of Brazil. The new country was huge, sparsely populated, and ethnically diverse.

Angleška čezmorska posest, včasih imenovana tudi Angleški imperij, je obsegala različna čezmorska ozemlja in kolonije, ki jih je Kraljevina Anglija osvojila ali kako drugače pridobila pred letom 1707, ko so akti o uniji Anglijo in Kraljevino Škotsko združili v Kraljevino Veliko Britanijo. Škoti so bili prej iz angleških čezmorskih posesti izključeni, po letu 1707 pa so lahko sodelovali v širitvi Britanskega imperija.

source.title: English overseas possessions
paragraphs: The English overseas possessions, sometimes referred to as the English Empire, comprised a variety of overseas territories and colonies that were conquered or otherwise acquired by the Kingdom of England before 1707 when the Acts of Union joined England with the Kingdom of Scotland and created of the Kingdom of Great Britain. Formerly Scots were excluded from English overseas possessions, but following 1707 they could participate in the expanding British Empire.

Federativna zveza (špansko: Liga Federal), znana tudi kot Zveza svobodnih ljudstev (Liga de los Pueblos Libres), je bila kratkotrajna konfederacija provinc v Južni Ameriki. Od leta 1815 do 1820 je skušala vzpostaviti konfederalno ureditev za državo, ki je v vojni za neodvisnost proti Španskemu imperiju nastajala iz majske revolucije na delu današnjega Urugvaja, Argentine in Brazilije.

Ustanovil in vodil jo je José Gervasio Artigas. Leta 1815 je razglasila neodvisnost od španske krone in na kongres v Tucumánu poslala pokrajinske delegate z nespremenljivim ciljem: razglasiti popolno neodvisnost Združenih provinc Río de la Plata in ustanoviti konfederacijo enakopravnih provinc, katerih vlade bi bile neposredno odgovorne svojim ljudstvom po načelih neposredne demokracije. Kongres, ki je 9. julija 1816 razglasil neodvisnost Združenih provinc Južne Amerike, je delegate teh provinc iz formalnih razlogov zavrnil.

source.title: Federal League (1815–1820)
paragraphs: The Federal League (Spanish: Liga Federal), also known as the League of the Free Peoples (Liga de los Pueblos Libres), was a short lived confederation of provinces located in South America. From 1815 to 1820 it tried to establish a confederal organization for the State that was emerging from the May Revolution in the war of independence against the Spanish Empire in part of what is now Uruguay, Argentina and Brazil.

Founded and led by José Gervasio Artigas, it proclaimed independence from the Spanish Crown in 1815 and sent provincial delegates to the Congress of Tucumán with instructions regarding the nonnegotiable objective of declaring full independence for the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata and establishing a confederation of provinces, all of them on equal footing and the government of each being directly accountable to its peoples by direct democratic means of government. The delegates from these provinces were rejected on formalities from the Congress that declared the independence of the United Provinces of South America on July 9, 1816.

Zvezna republika Srednja Amerika (špansko: República Federal de Centro América), sprva znana kot Združene province Srednje Amerike (Provincias Unidas del Centro de América), je bila suverena država v Srednji Ameriki, ki je obstajala od leta 1823 do 1839 oziroma 1841. Sestavljalo jo je pet držav (Kostarika, Salvador, Gvatemala, Honduras in Nikaragva), od leta 1835 do 1839 pa še zvezni okraj. Glavno mesto je bilo do leta 1834 mesto Gvatemala, nato so sedež vlade preselili v San Salvador. Na severu je mejila na Mehiko, na jugu na Veliko Kolumbijo, na vzhodu pa na Kraljestvo Mosquitia in Britanski Honduras, ki si ju je zvezna republika lastila.

source.title: Federal Republic of Central America
paragraphs: The Federal Republic of Central America (Spanish: República Federal de Centro América), initially known as the United Provinces of Central America (Provincias Unidas del Centro de América), was a sovereign state in Central America that existed between 1823 and 1839/1841. The republic was composed of five states (Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, and Nicaragua), and a Federal District from 1835 to 1839. Guatemala City was its capital city until 1834, when the seat of government was relocated to San Salvador. The Federal Republic of Central America was bordered on the north by Mexico, on the south by Gran Colombia and on the east by the Kingdom of Mosquitia and British Honduras, both claimed by the federal republic.

Prvo haitijsko cesarstvo, uradno Haitijsko cesarstvo (francosko: Empire d'Haïti, haitijsko kreolsko: Anpi an Ayiti), je bila volilna monarhija v Severni Ameriki. Haiti je bil pod francosko oblastjo, dokler ni 1. januarja 1804 razglasil neodvisnosti. Generalni guverner Haitija Jean-Jacques Dessalines je cesarstvo ustanovil 22. septembra 1804: ko so ga generali haitijske revolucionarne vojske razglasili za cesarja, je bil 6. oktobra kronan in privzel ime Jacques I. Ustava z dne 20. maja 1805 je določila ureditev cesarstva in državo razdelila na šest vojaških divizij, katerih poveljniki so bili neposredno odgovorni cesarju ali vrhovnemu poveljniku, ki ga je imenoval cesar. Določila je tudi nasledstvo: krona je bila volilna, vladajoči cesar pa je smel imenovati naslednika. Belcem, razen naturaliziranih Nemcev in Poljakov, je ustava prepovedala imeti lastnino v cesarstvu.

source.title: First Empire of Haiti
paragraphs: The First Empire of Haiti, officially known as the Empire of Haiti (French: Empire d'Haïti; Haitian Creole: Anpi an Ayiti), was an elective monarchy in North America. Haiti was controlled by France before declaring independence on 1 January 1804. The Governor-General of Haiti, Jean-Jacques Dessalines, created the empire on 22 September 1804. After being proclaimed emperor by the Generals of the Haitian Revolution Army, he held his coronation ceremony on 6 October and took the name Jacques I. The constitution of 20 May 1805 set out the way the empire was to be governed, with the country split into six military divisions. The general of each division corresponded directly with the emperor or the general in chief appointed by the emperor. The constitution also set out the succession to the throne, with the crown being elective and the reigning emperor having the power to appoint his successor. The constitution also banned white people, with the exception of naturalised Germans and Poles, from owning property inside the empire.

Mehiško cesarstvo (špansko: Imperio Mexicano) je bila ustavna monarhija in prva neodvisna vlada Mehike. Bilo je edino nekdanje podkraljestvo Španskega imperija, ki je po osamosvojitvi uvedlo monarhijo. Obstajalo je od leta 1821 do 1823 in je bilo ena redkih neodvisnih monarhij novega veka v Amerikah. Da bi ga ločili od poznejšega drugega mehiškega cesarstva (1864–1867) pod cesarjem Maksimilijanom, to obdobje običajno imenujejo prvo mehiško cesarstvo. Vodil ga je nekdanji častnik španske kraljeve vojske Agustín de Iturbide, ki je vladal kot Agustín I.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: First Mexican Empire
paragraphs: The Mexican Empire (Spanish: Imperio Mexicano, pronounced [imˈpeɾjo mexiˈkano] ) was a constitutional monarchy and the first independent government of Mexico. It was also the only former viceroyalty of the Spanish Empire to establish a monarchy after gaining independence. The empire existed from 1821 to 1823, making it one of the few modern-era independent monarchies in the Americas. To distinguish it from the later Second Mexican Empire (1864–1867) under Emperor Maximilian, this historical period is commonly referred to as the First Mexican Empire. The empire was led by former Royal Spanish military officer Agustín de Iturbide, who ruled as Agustín I.

Prva mehiška republika, znana tudi kot prva zvezna republika (špansko: Primera República Federal), je obstajala od leta 1824 do 1835. Bila je zvezna republika, ustanovljena z ustavo iz leta 1824, prvo ustavo neodvisne Mehike, uradno pa se je imenovala Združene mehiške države (Estados Unidos Mexicanos). Končala se je leta 1835, ko so jo konservativci pod vodstvom Antonia Lópeza de Santa Anne preoblikovali v unitarno državo, Centralistično republiko Mehiko.

Republiko je 1. novembra 1823 razglasila vrhovna izvršna oblast, nekaj mesecev po padcu Mehiškega cesarstva, ki mu je vladal cesar Agustín I., nekdanji rojalistični častnik, ki je prestopil na stran upornikov za neodvisnost. Zveza je bila uradno in pravno ustanovljena 4. oktobra 1824, ko je začela veljati zvezna ustava Združenih mehiških držav.

source.title: First Mexican Republic
paragraphs: The First Mexican Republic, known also as the First Federal Republic (Spanish: Primera República Federal), existed from 1824 to 1835. It was a federated republic, established by the Constitution of 1824, the first constitution of independent Mexico, and officially designated the United Mexican States (Spanish: Estados Unidos Mexicanos). It ended in 1835, when conservatives under Antonio López de Santa Anna transformed it into a unitary state, the Centralist Republic of Mexico.

The republic was proclaimed on 1 November 1823 by the Supreme Executive Power, months after the fall of the Mexican Empire ruled by emperor Agustin I, a former royalist military officer-turned-insurgent for independence. The federation was formally and legally established on 4 October 1824, when the Federal Constitution of the United Mexican States came into force.

Španska republika (špansko: República española), v zgodovinopisju imenovana prva španska republika (Primera República española), je bila politična ureditev, ki je v Španiji obstajala od 11. februarja 1873 do 29. decembra 1874.

Republika je nastala po abdikaciji kralja Amadeja 10. februarja 1873, naslednji dan pa jo je razglasila parlamentarna večina radikalcev, republikancev in demokratov. Obdobje so zaznamovale napetosti med federalističnimi in unitarnimi republikanci. Ukinili so obvezno vojaško službo, uredili otroško delo in odpravili suženjstvo v Portoriku. Vlada je podedovala vojno stanje: tretjo karlistično vojno, ki je trajala od leta 1872, in desetletno vojno na Kubi, ki je trajala od leta 1868; leta 1873 se jima je pridružil še kantonalni upor.

source.title: First Spanish Republic
paragraphs: The Spanish Republic (Spanish: República española), historiographically referred to as the First Spanish Republic (Spanish: Primera República española), was the political regime that existed in Spain from 11 February 1873 to 29 December 1874.

The Republic was founded after the abdication of King Amadeo on 10 February 1873. On the next day a republic was proclaimed by a parliamentary majority made up of radicals, republicans and democrats. The period was beset by tensions between federal republicans and unitary republicans. The period also saw the end of compulsory conscription, the regulation of child labor and the abolition of slavery in Puerto Rico. The government inherited a state of war, the so-called Third Carlist War, ongoing since 1872, and the Ten Years' War in Cuba, ongoing since 1868, to which was added the Cantonal Rebellion in 1873.

French Louisiana.headline: Francoska Louisiana
paragraphs: Izraz Francoska Louisiana (francosko: Louisiane française, v louisianski kreolščini: Lwizyàn françé) označuje dve različni zgodovinski pokrajini:
prvič zgodovinsko Francosko Louisiano, obsežni osrednji del Severne Amerike, ki si ga je Francija lastila v 17. in 18. stoletju,
in drugič sodobno Francosko Louisiano, ki se razteza čez južno tretjino današnje zvezne države Louisiana in jo imenujejo tudi Akadija, dežela Cajunov ali kreolska dežela.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: French Louisiana
paragraphs: The term French Louisiana (French: Louisiane française [lwizjan fʁɑ̃sɛːz]; Louisiana Creole: Lwizyàn françé) refers to two distinct, historical regions:
First, to historic French Louisiana, comprising the massive, middle section of North America claimed by France during the 17th and 18th centuries; and,
Second, to modern French Louisiana, which stretches across the southern third of the present-day State of Louisiana, also called Acadia, Cajun Country, or Creole Country.

Glacial Kame culture.headline: Kultura Glacial Kame
paragraphs: Kultura Glacial Kame je bila kultura arhaičnih ljudstev Severne Amerike, ki je od okoli leta 8000 do 1000 pr. n. št. poseljevala južni Ontario, Michigan, Ohio in Indiano. Ime je dobila po navadi, da so mrtve pokopavali na vrhovih prodnatih gričev, ki jih je odložil ledenik (kame). Med najpogostejšimi najdbami na njenih najdiščih so lupine morskih živali in izdelki iz samorodnega bakra (float copper).

source.title: Glacial Kame culture
paragraphs: The Glacial Kame culture was a culture of Archaic people in North America that occupied southern Ontario, Michigan, Ohio, and Indiana from around 8000 BC to 1000 BC. The name of this culture derives from its members' practice of burying their dead atop glacier-deposited gravel hills. Among the most common types of artifacts found at Glacial Kame sites are shells of marine animals and goods manufactured from a copper ore, known as float copper.

Gran Coclé.headline: Gran Coclé
paragraphs: Gran Coclé je arheološko kulturno območje na jugu predkolumbovske Srednje Amerike. Prej so ga imenovali Spodnja Srednja Amerika ali vmesno območje, a ta izraza danes veljata za zastarela. Območje se v glavnem ujema z današnjo panamsko provinco Coclé in je obsegalo več prepoznavnih domorodnih kultur, ki so jih arheologi okvirno razmejili po slogu lončenine. Slabo raziskano obdobje La Mula je trajalo od leta 150 pr. n. št. do leta 300 n. št., sledili sta mu obdobje Tonosí od leta 300 do 550 in obdobje Cubitá od leta 550 do 700. Na tem območju je približno od leta 1200 pr. n. št. do 16. stoletja očitno cvetela enotna domorodna kultura.

source.title: Gran Coclé
paragraphs: Gran Coclé is an archaeological culture area in the south of in pre-Columbian Central America. This area used to be referred to as Lower Central America or the Intermediate Area, but these terms are now seen as out-dated. The area largely coincides with the modern-day Panamanian province of Coclé, and consisted of a number of identifiable native cultures. Archaeologists have loosely designated these cultures by pottery style. The poorly studied La Mula period ranged from 150 BC to AD 300. It was followed by the Tonosi period, from AD 300 to AD 550, and by the Cubita period, from AD 550 to AD 700. A unified Native American culture appears to have flourished in this area from approximately 1200 BC until the 16th century.

Granadska konfederacija (špansko: Confederación Granadina) je bila kratkotrajna zvezna republika, ustanovljena leta 1858 z ustavno spremembo, ki je nadomestila Republiko Novo Granado. Obsegala je današnji državi Kolumbijo in Panamo ter dele severozahodne Brazilije. Po novi ustavni spremembi leta 1863 so jo nadomestile Združene države Kolumbije.

source.title: Granadine Confederation
paragraphs: The Granadine Confederation (Spanish: Confederación Granadina) was a short-lived federal republic established in 1858 as a result of a constitutional change replacing the Republic of New Granada. It consisted of the present-day nations of Colombia and Panama and parts of northwestern Brazil. In turn, the Granadine Confederation was replaced by the United States of Colombia after another constitutional change in 1863.

Itza people.headline: Itzaji
paragraphs: Itzaji so majevska etnična skupina, potomci ljudstva Chanes iz pokrajine Chontal v Tabascu. V 10. stoletju so se preselili v Bacalar in na sever Jukatana, pozneje prišli v Champotón, v 15. stoletju pa so se naselili ob jezeru Petén Itzá, kjer so ostali neodvisni do leta 1697. V španskem kolonialnem obdobju in pozneje pod gvatemalsko vlado so bili žrtve zatiralne politike, ki je pospešila izumiranje njihove kulture in jezika, zato so izgubili velik del etnične identitete.

So ena najmanjših majevskih skupin z najmanj pripadniki: redki potomci živijo v kraju San José severno od jezera Petén Itzá v departmaju Petén v Gvatemali in so se močno prilagodili mestiški družbi, jezik kot materni govori le še 36 starejših ljudi.

source.title: Itza people
paragraphs: The Itza are a Maya ethnic group. They are descendants of the Chanes from the Chontal region of Tabasco. They migrated to Bacalar and northern Yucatán during the 10th century, later arriving to Champotón and finally in the 15th century settling around Lake Petén Itzá where they remained independent until 1697. During the Spanish colonial era and later by the Guatemalan government, the Itza were victims of repressive policies that accelerated the extinction of the Itza culture and language, leading to the loss of much of their ethnic identity.

They are one of the smallest Maya groups and have the lowest population; the few Itza descendants are settled in the town of San José, north of Lake Petén Itzá in the department of Petén, Guatemala, and are considered highly acculturated to mestizo society, with only 36 elderly people remaining as native speakers of the language.

Jesuit missions among the Guaraní.headline: Jezuitski misijoni med Gvarani
paragraphs: Jezuitski misijoni med Gvarani so bili naselbine za ljudstvo Gvarani (»Indijance« ali »Indios«) na območju ob meji današnje Argentine, Brazilije in Paragvaja, ki ga domačini imenujejo tromeja. Misijone je v začetku 17. stoletja ustanovil jezuitski red katoliške cerkve, končali pa so se konec 18. stoletja, ko so red izgnali iz Amerik. Nekateri jih označujejo za poskus »socialistične teokracije« ali za redek primer »benignega kolonializma«. Drugi pravijo, da so »jezuiti Indijancem vzeli svobodo, jih prisilili v korenito spremembo načina življenja, jih telesno zlorabljali in izpostavili boleznim«.

Španski in Portugalski imperij sta v na novo pridobljenih južnoameriških posestih domorodno prebivalstvo zbirala v skupnosti, imenovane »indijanske redukcije« (špansko: reducciones de indios, portugalsko: reduções). Njihov namen je bil širiti krščanstvo in evropsko kulturo. Redukcije so ustanavljale tako posvetne kot cerkvene oblasti.

source.title: Jesuit missions among the Guaraní
paragraphs: The Jesuit missions among the Guaraní were a type of settlement for the Guaraní people ("Indians" or "Indios") in an area straddling the borders of present-day Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay, known locally as the triple frontier. The missions were established by the Jesuit Order of the Catholic Church early in the 17th century and ended in the late 18th century after the expulsion of the order from the Americas. The missions have been called an experiment in "socialist theocracy" or a rare example of "benign colonialism". Others have said that "the Jesuits took away the Indians' freedom, forced them to radically change their lifestyle, physically abused them, and subjected them to disease".

In their newly acquired South American dominions, the Spanish and Portuguese Empires adopted a strategy of gathering native populations into communities called "Indian reductions" (Spanish: reducciones de indios, Portuguese: reduções). The objectives of the reductions were to impart Christianity and European culture. Secular as well as religious authorities created "reductions".

Kingdom of Nicoya.headline: Kraljestvo Nicoya
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Nicoya (iz nahuatla: Nekok Yaotl), imenovano tudi kacikat ali gospostvo Nicoya, je bila domorodna skupnost, ki je obsegala večino ozemlja današnje province Guanacaste na severnem pacifiškem delu Kostarike. Njeno politično, gospodarsko in versko središče je bilo mesto Nicoya na istoimenskem polotoku, ki so mu bile podrejene številne pokrajine na obeh bregovih zaliva Nicoya in mnoge vasi, ki so mu plačevale davek. V 16. stoletju, pred prihodom Evropejcev, je bila Nicoya najpomembnejše poglavarstvo na severnem pacifiškem delu današnje Kostarike.

source.title: Kingdom of Nicoya
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Nicoya (from Nahuatl: Nekok Yaotl), also called Cacicazgo or Lordship of Nicoya, was an indigenous nation that comprised much of the territory of the current Guanacaste Province, in the North Pacific of Costa Rica. Its political, economic and religious center was the city of Nicoya, located on the peninsula of the same name, which depends on several provinces located on both banks of the Gulf of Nicoya, as well as numerous tributary villages. In the 16th century, prior to the arrival of Europeans, Nicoya was the most important chiefdom of the North Pacific of present-day Costa Rica.

Las Ánimas complex.headline: Kompleks Las Ánimas
paragraphs: Kompleks Las Ánimas je arheološka kultura severnega Čila, ki velja za neposredno predhodnico kulture Diaguita. Razvila se je med letoma 800 in 1000 n. št. v čilski pokrajini Norte Chico. Pred njo je na tem območju od leta 300 do 700 n. št. obstajala arheološka kultura, imenovana kompleks El Molle.

source.title: Las Ánimas complex
paragraphs: Las Ánimas complex is an archaeological culture of northern Chile considered to be the immediate precursor to the Diaguita culture. The culture developed in the Chilean region of Norte Chico between 800 and 1000 CE. Prior to Las Ánimas complex, an archaeological culture known as El Molle complex existed in Norte Chico from 300 to 700 CE.

Lucayan people.headline: Lukajci
paragraphs: Lukajci so bili domorodno ljudstvo Bahamov ter otokov Turks in Caicos pred evropsko kolonizacijo Amerik. Po mnenju nekaterih raziskovalcev, med njimi Juliana Granberryja in Garyja Vesceliusa, so bili veja Tainov, ki so poseljevali večino Karibov in Bahamov. Drugi raziskovalci, med njimi L. Antonio Curet, jih med Taine ne uvrščajo. Lukajci so bili prvi ameriški staroselci, s katerimi se je (oktobra 1492) srečal Krištof Kolumb. Kmalu po stiku so jih Španci začeli ugrabljati in zasužnjevati ter jih do leta 1520 z Bahamov povsem iztrebili.

Ime »Lucayan« je poangleščena oblika španskega Lucayos, ta pa je pošpanjena oblika lukajskega imena Lukku-Cairi, s katerim so se imenovali sami in ki pomeni »ljudje z otokov«. Lukajska beseda za otok, cairi, se je v španščini spremenila v cayo, v angleščini pa v cay (v ameriški angleščini pisano »key«).
notes: Lukajci is the form chosen for the Lucayans; worth a reviewer's check.

source.title: Lucayan people
paragraphs: The Lucayan people ( loo-KY-ən) were the Indigenous people of the Bahamas and the Turks and Caicos Islands before the European colonisation of the Americas. According to some scholars, including Julian Granberry and Gary Vescelius, they were a branch of the Taínos who inhabited most of the Caribbean and the Bahamas. Other scholars, including L. Antonio Curet, do not classify Lucayans as Taínos. The Lucayans were the first Indigenous Americans encountered by Christopher Columbus (in October 1492). Shortly after contact, the Spanish kidnapped and enslaved Lucayans with the displacement culminating in the complete eradication of the Lucayan people from the Bahamas by 1520.

The name "Lucayan" is an Anglicization of the Spanish Lucayos, itself a hispanicization derived from the Lucayan Lukku-Cairi, which the people used for themselves, meaning "people of the islands". The Lucayan word for "island", cairi, became cayo in Spanish and "cay" in English [spelled "key" in American English].

Machalilla culture.headline: Kultura Machalilla
paragraphs: Machalilla so bili prazgodovinsko ljudstvo v Ekvadorju, na jugu province Manabí in na polotoku Santa Elena. Kdaj je kultura cvetela, ni zanesljivo, a običajno velja, da je trajala od leta 1500 do 1100 pr. n. št.

source.title: Machalilla culture
paragraphs: The Machalilla were a prehistoric people in Ecuador, in southern Manabí and the Santa Elena Peninsula. The dates when the culture thrived are uncertain, but are generally agreed to encompass 1500 BCE to 1100 BCE.

Mangue people.headline: Ljudstvo Mangue
paragraphs: Mangue, znani tudi kot Chorotega, so etnična skupina, doma v Srednji Ameriki. Ob prvih stikih s Španci v 16. stoletju so poseljevali pacifiške nižine Nikaragve in Hondurasa ter severozahodno Kostariko, v manjšem številu pa tudi skrajni vzhod Salvadorja. Jezik mangue, ki je izumrl v 20. stoletju, je spadal v oto-mangvansko jezikovno družino, ki se delno imenuje prav po njem kot njenem najjužnejšem članu.

Ocene o številu današnjih Mangue v Nikaragvi se močno razlikujejo: od okoli 10.000 leta 1981 in 46.000 po popisu leta 2005 do 166.000 po oceni Mednarodne organizacije dela iz leta 2006, 210.000 po navedbah aktivistov Chorotega in 221.000 po podatkih Mednarodne delovne skupine za domorodne zadeve. V Guaitilu v Kostariki so se Mangue zlili s kostariško kulturo in izgubili jezik, ohranili pa so lončarske tehnike in sloge. Matambú je edino domorodno ozemlje Chorotega v Kostariki.

source.title: Mangue people
paragraphs: The Mangue, also known as the Chorotega, are an ethnic group native to Central America. At the time of Spanish contact in the sixteenth century, they inhabited the Pacific lowlands of Nicaragua and Honduras, northwestern Costa Rica, and in smaller numbers easternmost El Salvador. The Mangue language has been extinct since the 20th century and belonged to the Oto-Manguean family, partially named for the Mangue as the southernmost member.

Estimates of the modern Mangue population in Nicaragua vary widely, from around 10,000 in 1981, to 46,000 according to the 2005 census, 166,000 according to an International Labour Organization estimate in 2006, 210,000 according to Chorotega activists, and 221,000 according to the International Work Group for Indigenous Affairs. In Guaitil, Costa Rica, the Mangue have been absorbed into the Costa Rican culture, losing their language, but pottery techniques and styles have been preserved. Matambú is the only Chorotega indigenous territory in Costa Rica.

Middle Archaic.headline: Srednje arhaično obdobje
paragraphs: Arhaično obdobje Severne Amerike je v razvrstitvi tamkajšnjih arheoloških kultur obdobje arhaične stopnje kulturnega razvoja, ki v zaporedju predkolumbovskih kulturnih stopenj traja približno od 8000 do 1000 pr. n. št. Zanj je značilno samooskrbno gospodarstvo, ki je temeljilo na nabiranju oreškov, semen in školjk. Ker konec obdobja določa prehod na stalno poljedelstvo, se njegov datum po Amerikah precej razlikuje.
Izraz »arhaično obdobje« označuje tudi časovna obdobja drugod po Amerikah, ki pa trajajo drugače kot severnoameriško.
notes: The English article read for this era is the introduction of the whole Archaic period ("Middle Archaic" redirects there), so the summary covers more than the middle phase.

source.title: Archaic period (North America)
paragraphs: In the classification of the archaeological cultures of North America, the Archaic period in North America, taken to last from around 8000 to 1000 BC in the sequence of North American pre-Columbian cultural stages, is a period defined by the archaic stage of cultural development. The Archaic stage is characterized by subsistence economies supported through the exploitation of nuts, seeds, and shellfish. As its ending is defined by the adoption of sedentary farming, this date can vary significantly across the Americas.
The term "Archaic Period" is also as a timespan label elsewhere in the Americas, with different timespans than the North American Archaic.

Mixtec culture.headline: Mikstekška kultura
paragraphs: Mikstekška kultura (imenovana tudi mikstekška civilizacija) je bila predkolumbovska arheološka kultura prednikov Mikstekov, ki so se imenovali Ñuu savi (ime, ki ga potomci ohranjajo še danes), kar pomeni »ljudje ali narod dežja«. Prve sledi segajo v srednje predklasično obdobje Mezoamerike (od 12. do 10. stoletja pr. n. št.), končala pa se je s španskim osvajanjem v prvih desetletjih 16. stoletja. Zgodovinsko ozemlje tega ljudstva je območje La Mixteca (v stari mikstekščini Ñuu Dzahui), gorata pokrajina med današnjimi mehiškimi zveznimi državami Puebla, Oaxaca in Guerrero.

source.title: Mixtec culture
paragraphs: The Mixtec culture (also called the Mixtec civilization) was a pre-Columbian archaeological culture, corresponding to the ancestors of the Mixtec people; they called themselves Ñuu savi (a name that their descendants still preserve), which means "people or nation of the rain". It had its first manifestations in the Mesoamerican Middle Preclassic period (12th century BC – 10th century BC) and ended with the Spanish conquest in the first decades of the 16th century. The historical territory of this people is the area known as La Mixteca (Ñuu Dzahui, in ancient Mixtec), a mountainous region located between the current Mexican states of Puebla, Oaxaca, and Guerrero.

Woodland period#Early Woodland period (1.headline: Zgodnje gozdno obdobje
paragraphs: Zgodnje gozdno obdobje (Early Woodland) je nadaljevalo številne težnje, ki so se začele v poznem in končnem arhaičnem obdobju: obsežno gradnjo gomil, regionalno značilne pogrebne komplekse, trgovino z eksotičnim blagom na velikem delu Severne Amerike v okviru t. i. interakcijskih sfer, prehrano iz divjih in udomačenih rastlin ter mobilno preživetje, pri katerem so manjše skupine izkoriščale sezonske vire, kot so oreški, ribe, školjke in divje rastline. Lončenina, ki so jo v arhaičnem obdobju izdelovali le v omejenih količinah, se je zdaj razširila po vsem vzhodnem notranjem delu, jugovzhodu in severovzhodu. Skrajni severovzhod, subarktika ter severozahod in Velike planjave so jo na splošno prevzeli nekoliko pozneje, okoli leta 200 pr. n. št.
notes: Woodland period rendered as gozdno obdobje with the English term at first mention; no established Slovenian term was found.

source.title: Woodland period
paragraphs: The Early Woodland period continued many trends begun during the Late and Terminal Archaic periods, including extensive mound-building, regional distinctive burial complexes, the trade of exotic goods across a large area of North America as part of interaction spheres, the reliance on both wild and domesticated plant foods, and a mobile subsistence strategy in which small groups took advantage of seasonally available resources such as nuts, fish, shellfish, and wild plants. Pottery, which had been manufactured during the Archaic period in limited amounts, was now widespread across the Eastern Interior, the Southeast, and the Northeast. The Far Northeast, the Sub-Arctic, and the Northwest/Plains regions widely adopted pottery somewhat later, about 200 BCE.

Woodland period#Late Woodland Period (50.headline: Pozno gozdno obdobje
paragraphs: Pozno gozdno obdobje je bilo čas, ko se je prebivalstvo očitno razpršilo, čeprav se ni zmanjšalo. Na večini območij sta močno upadli gradnja grobnih gomil in trgovina z eksotičnimi surovinami na velike razdalje. Hkrati sta lok in puščica postopoma izpodrinila sulico in metalec kopja (atlatl). Pravo intenzivno poljedelstvo se je začelo šele v naslednjem, misisipijskem obdobju, a je že začetek resnega obdelovanja zemlje močno dopolnil tradicionalno nabiranje rastlin.

source.title: Woodland period
paragraphs: The late Woodland period was a time of apparent population dispersal, although populations do not appear to have decreased. In most areas, the construction of burial mounds decreased markedly, as did the long-distance trade in exotic materials. At the same time, bow and arrow technology gradually overtook the use of the spear and atlatl. While full-scale intensive agriculture did not begin until the following Mississippian period, the beginning of serious cultivation greatly supplemented the traditional gathering of plants.

Woodland period#Middle Woodland Period (.headline: Srednje gozdno obdobje
paragraphs: Na začetku srednjega gozdnega obdobja so se naselbine preselile v notranjost celine. Z napredovanjem obdobja se je krajevna in medregionalna trgovina z eksotičnimi surovinami tako razmahnila, da je trgovska mreža zajela večino vzhodnih gozdov (Eastern Woodlands). Po vsem jugovzhodu in severno od reke Ohio so bile grobne gomile pomembnih ljudi zelo razkošne, z raznolikimi pogrebnimi pridatki, ki so bili pogosto tujega izvora. Med blagom, s katerim so trgovali, so bili baker iz nahajališč ob Gornjem jezeru, srebro z Gornjega jezera in zlasti iz Ontaria, galenit iz Missourija in Illinoisa, sljuda iz južnih Apalačev, roženec z različnih krajev, med drugim iz Ohia, Indiane in Illinoisa, pipni kamen iz Ohia in Illinoisa, aligatorski zobje od spodnjega toka Misisipija proti vzhodu do Floride, morske školjke, zlasti trobilke, z južne atlantske in zalivske obale, kalcedon z reke Knife v Severni Dakoti ter obsidian iz Yellowstona v Wyomingu.

source.title: Woodland period
paragraphs: The beginning of the Middle Woodland saw a shift of settlement to the Interior. As the Woodland period progressed, local and inter-regional trade of exotic materials greatly increased to the point where a trade network covered most of the Eastern Woodlands. Throughout the Southeast and north of the Ohio River, burial mounds of important people were very elaborate and contained a variety of mortuary gifts, many of which were not local. Among the traded materials were copper from the Lake Superior deposits; silver from Lake Superior and especially Ontario; galena from Missouri and Illinois; mica from the southern Appalachians; chert from various places including Ohio, Indiana, and Illinois; pipestone from Ohio and Illinois; alligator teeth from the lower Mississippi Valley eastward to Florida; marine shells, especially whelks, from the south Atlantic and Gulf coasts; Knife River chalcedony from North Dakota; and obsidian from Yellowstone in Wyoming.
